agent.report:
I changed nothing in the repository, so there was nothing to commit; `main` is still at `38cc90c` and the tree is clean. To check the list, I set the constant to 30 in a scratch copy outside the repo. Unit tests: 6 tests in 3 suites failed (of 1049). E2e tests: 3 tests in 2 suites failed (of 607). The same 5 suites pass at 14 days (72/72). I removed the scratch copy afterwards.

Things I decided or could not settle:
- **Claims are excluded.** `src/Contexts/Support/Domain/Claim/ClaimRules.ts` has its own `CLAIM_WINDOW_DAYS = 14`. ADR 74 calls the claim window "the same window as a review's", but the code doesn't link them. If the team means claims to follow, that adds `ClaimRules.ts` and `ClaimExceptions.ts` to the lists.
- **Contract and docs also say 14 days and would go stale**, but they aren't source files, so they're not in the lists: `conventions/domain.yaml` (the Reviews purpose and the "Review window" term), `conventions/storms/reviews.yaml`, ADRs 0059, 0060, 0062 and 0074, and comments in the e2e specs.
- **Ratings and listing order change without a code change.** Booking search by rating, the Listings rating and the host rating all read published reviews, so they shift when the window closes later.

```yaml
rules:
  - Review window: a stay is reviewed from the day after check-out up to N days after it; refused outside it (REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS, isInReviewWindow, OutsideReviewWindow)
  - Publication: a stay's two reviews are published together, when both are written or the window closes (isPublished, windowClosed; ADR 60)
  - Reply to a review only once published (replyToTravellerReview, ReviewNotPublished)
  - Report a review: an unpublished review is not found by anyone but its author (reportReview; ADR 63)
  - Reads show a review only when published: booking, listing and guest reviews (publishedOn)
  - Ratings count only published traveller reviews, for listings and hosts (ratingOf, publishedTravellerReviews; ADR 61)
files:
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/ReviewWindow.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewExceptions.ts
tests:
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviews.spec.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/StayReviewReports.spec.ts
  - src/Contexts/Reviews/Domain/StayReview/Rating.spec.ts
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/reviews.e2e.spec.ts
  - src/Bootstrap/Fastify/ratings.e2e.spec.ts
```
